physicalNotes: Radius 0.85 solar radii from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 0.85 solar radii (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684): 591,345 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.8 solar masses from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 0.8 solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4440 K from Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row K5V, for SIMBAD's spectral type K5V: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt). Spin inclination 60 degrees and rotation period 3.7 d from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 3.7 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
